purpose: Add a bounded plant-level operating context around Packaging Line 1 so maintenance workload, staffing availability, work orders, and neighboring lines change on the same deterministic shift calendar.

maintenance_staffing.dispatch_model: Each synthetic shift generates a small deterministic workload. Jobs are assigned to the earliest compatible technician; current LineAlert maintenance ETA is derived from present technician occupancy rather than a fixed timer.
maintenance_staffing.boundary: Synthetic availability is operational context only. It is not authorization, a staffing recommendation, or a substitute for plant dispatch rules.

cmms_work_generation.arrival_behavior: Jobs become visible when their deterministic arrival time is reached; future jobs appear as incoming work in the public demo.

maintenance_eta_input: remaining duration of active synthetic work
line_state_input: active LineAlert concern on Packaging Line 1
operational_interaction.fast_forward_rule: Calendar, production counters, staffing state, and work-order state advance together; the demo returns to 1x before the next LineAlert concern.
operational_interaction.linealert_role: observe context and revise bounded operational guidance; do not create hidden equipment effects or autonomous dispatch changes

current_scope_limit: Only Packaging Line 1 retains the full interactive bounded-trial workflow in this increment. Other lines provide ambient operating and maintenance demand. Fleet-wide incident-specific troubleshooting remains future scope.
